diagnostics.message: module.fargate_profile:resource.aws_eks_fargate_profile.this must wait for module.fargate_profile:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this so the pod execution role has its required execution policy before profile creation, and retains it until profile deletion. Referencing the role ARN does not order policy attachment.

module.eks_managed_node_group:resource.aws_eks_node_group.this needs ordering on module.eks_managed_node_group:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this to ensure worker, registry, and applicable CNI permissions exist before nodes launch and remain until deletion. The launch-template dependency is not sufficient when using an external template or disabling custom launch templates.

When creating the IPv6 CNI policy locally, :module.eks_managed_node_group must wait for :resource.aws_iam_policy.cni_ipv6_policy. Its IAM attachments reconstruct the policy ARN by name rather than referencing the policy, allowing attachment before the policy exists.

When creating the IPv6 CNI policy locally, :module.self_managed_node_group must wait for :resource.aws_iam_policy.cni_ipv6_policy. The child IAM attachments construct the policy ARN from its fixed name, with no dependency ensuring policy creation precedes attachment.

When creating the IPv6 CNI policy locally, :module.fargate_profile must wait for :resource.aws_iam_policy.cni_ipv6_policy. The child constructs its CNI policy ARN by name, so attachments can otherwise run before the policy exists.
